name: Simple Fatoora
author: Future Base

sections.description:
Simple Fatoora connects your WooCommerce store to an officially authorized ZATCA E‑Invoicing Provider.
With full support for ZATCA Phase One and Phase Two (Integration Phase), the plugin automatically generates secure e‑invoices, QR codes, cryptographic stamps, invoice UUIDs, XML signing, and real‑time reporting — all through the Simple Fatoora platform.

Why Simple Fatoora?

  • ✔ Authorized ZATCA Solution Provider
  • ✔ 100% Phase Two compliant (Integration Phase)
  • ✔ Auto‑generate invoices from WooCommerce orders
  • ✔ TLV‑based ZATCA QR codes included in emails & PDFs
  • ✔ Customer VAT fields supported at checkout
  • ✔ Secure, reliable invoice storage on Simple Fatoora servers
  • ✔ Fast setup: Create account, log in, or connect via API key

Key Features

  • Automatic ZATCA‑compliant invoice generation
  • Manual invoice generation from the order page
  • Display QR codes in emails and invoice PDFs
  • Full support for Simplified & Standard invoices
  • ZATCA real‑time compliance checks
  • Customer VAT/company invoice support
  • API health checks
  • Compatible with leading PDF invoice plugins
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins menu or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Simple Fatoora.
  4. Create a Simple Fatoora account, log in, or connect using your API key.
  5. Select your invoice type and preferred auto‑generation triggers.
  6. Save settings — your WooCommerce store is now ZATCA‑compliant.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Simple Fatoora account?

Yes.
You can create an account directly inside the plugin, log in, or connect via API key.
All e‑invoices, QR codes, and ZATCA submissions are securely processed through Simple Fatoora.

Does this plugin generate QR codes?

Yes.
The plugin fetches ZATCA‑approved TLV QR codes from Simple Fatoora and displays them in:
– WooCommerce customer emails
– Order details
– PDF invoices

Is Simple Fatoora an authorized ZATCA provider?

Yes.
Simple Fatoora is an officially recognized Authorized ZATCA Solution Provider.

Does this plugin support ZATCA Phase Two (Integration Phase)?

Yes.
The plugin supports all requirements for Phase Two through Simple Fatoora’s compliant platform.

Does the plugin automatically generate invoices?

Yes.
You can choose which WooCommerce order status triggers invoice creation.
The system prevents duplicate invoices and ensures compliance.

Can I generate invoices manually?

Yes — directly from the WooCommerce order screen.

Does this plugin store invoices in WordPress?

No.
All invoice data, QR codes, hashes, and XML files remain securely stored on Simple Fatoora.

Does the plugin support Simplified and Standard invoices?

Yes — both invoice types are supported.

Can customers enter VAT/company details?

Yes.
Optional fields can be enabled during checkout for company/VAT invoicing.
sections.changelog:
1.5.1

  • Fixed an issue where full refund credit notes could generate incorrect totals when taxes are included in prices.
  • Improved consistency between invoice and credit note calculations, ensuring refunded amounts (including shipping and VAT) match the original invoice.
  • Enhanced refund handling logic to better align with WooCommerce tax and shipping settings.

1.5.0

  • Added strict validation for the company VAT number field on checkout: must be exactly 15 digits and start with 3 (with inline Arabic / English hints).
  • Added matching VAT number validation helper on the WooCommerce admin order editor VAT field.
  • Improved Simple Fatoora settings page labels and UX in the plugin settings tab.

1.4.9

  • Added Invoice Type selection in the admin order editor (Simplified vs VAT Invoice).
  • Added company name and company VAT fields for admin-created orders.
  • Improved VAT invoice handling across admin, checkout, emails, thank-you page, and Simple Fatoora API.
  • Fixed email invoice block not showing for certain stores.
  • Added new FAQs tab with accordion-style layout and improved documentation.
  • Improved Invoice Settings page UI and cleaned old/unneeded settings.
  • Fixed several PHP notices and improved order meta logic.
  • Ensured auto-generation only triggers on the selected WooCommerce order status.
  • Updated frontend invoice info display to dynamically reflect the correct invoice type.

1.4.6

  • Added checkout option for VAT / company invoices.
  • Updated order metadata to support Simple Fatoora VAT invoice payload.

1.4.3

  • Improved styling for the settings page.
  • Added configurable “auto-generate invoice” status.
  • Added option to include invoice information in customer emails.

1.4.2

  • Internal improvements to settings layout and error handling.

1.4.1

  • Initial integration of the new Simple Fatoora settings tab UI.
  • Compatibility updates for WooCommerce and WordPress 6.8.
